title: MASEMiner
tagline: Extract factor loadings, inter-factor correlations, and study metadata for Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling
description: MASEMiner workflow for factor-analytic meta-analysis.  Fill in the scale name, the item count, the maximum factor count, and (optionally) the item labels and factor names in the in-app builder — the prompt is generated automatically.  A TAS-20 example is one click away.
task_description: Extract item-level factor loadings, inter-factor correlations, and coded study/sample metadata for every sample reported in the paper.
context: MASEMiner workflow tailored for factor-analytic primary studies. Configure the scale name, item count, max factors, and optional item / factor labels in the builder before running.
